angle: DL/EDGE: Run-the-Hoop bend (Hoop G) vs NFL bend, corner turns and career pressure rate, year-standardized, leave-one-class-out against pick + role (headline, the forecast frozen for 2026), pick only and a ridge-shrunk full no-tracking forecast (pick, role, weight, NGS score, 10-yd split, 3-cone); pass-rush-drill burst tested in the same six-measure family
metric_name: Hoop G: hardest half-second of sideways lean on the Run-the-Hoop figure-eight (speed^2 / turn radius, in g), z within Combine year
headline_number: Held out (n=77): +2.3 pressures per 450 rushes per sd [0.9, 3.7] against pick + role; +3.2 against pick only, +2.4 against the ridge-shrunk full forecast; R2 gain 0.06 [-0.10, 0.20] by rusher resampling and [-0.08, 0.20] by NFL-team resampling. Placebo: real slope beats 100% of 5,000 within-class-and-role shuffles (p = 0.001). Only +0.2 [-0.1, 0.6] of the 2.3 runs through measured NFL bend. Day-3 top third: 9/15 for both Hoop G and pick order.
what_changed_from_previous: Revision of round 23 cand_1 (8.50). DS: headline comparator switched from the overfitting full OLS forecast (held-out R2 -0.04) to pick + role (the forecast frozen for the 2026 test) and every downstream residual analysis rescored against it; ridge-shrunk full forecast added; team-cluster bootstrap of the R2 gain; within-class and within-class-x-role placebo (5,000 shuffles each); mediation Hoop G -> NFL bend -> pressure on the same 77 (indirect 8%); disattenuated slope (3.5) shown as secondary; both-turns variant (1.5) promoted to the body; EPA filter traced (1,681 rows / 135 -> 1,655 plays / 132; any-rusher flag 134, same 0.52 EPA). verify.py now re-implements the pick + role slope (2.3 [0.8, 3.8], same 77). Football: fixed Monday rule with expected count (about 8 names a class, 6-10), miss share and cost of a miss (4.7 pressures a season, film time only); NFL-half vs drill-half reconciled through the mediation result; play-log checks (not film) for Solomon (hit) and Harrell (miss) from alignment, corner turns, completions and NGS get-off; film reads now computed (Watts, not Harrell, is furthest below forecast; unsupported 'hips there' removed). Writeup: lede numbers stated once, why-now sentence, Table 2 cut to three rows with a plain-language caption, fold-chosen/full-OLS/six-measure screen/power/multiplicity moved to appendix, jargon replaced. Viz: Fig 1 overlays the three hoop laps in one panel with time ticks and shape markers, NFL fans per man with text below the traces; reliability figure dropped; new Fig 2 (placebo histogram + mediation); film-list chart rebuilt as a table-plus-interval chart with class-rank column, data-driven axis limits (no clipping) and value labels kept off the margin band; six-measure screen moved to the appendix with fixed label placement.
open_risks: Switching the headline comparator to pick + role after round 23 can read as a forking path; it was the frozen 2026 comparator already, and the full-OLS (2.2) and ridge (2.4) slopes are reported beside it
R2 gain intervals still span zero under both rusher and team resampling; the best-of-six p is 0.05, right at the chance line
Mediation shows only 8% of the slope runs through measured NFL bend, so the drill-to-game mechanism stays unidentified
Day-3 top-third hit rate is 9/15 for Hoop G and for pick order: no evidence Hoop G picks better tape
Play-log checks are not film: 20 sampled snaps per man, no blockers or video; Solomon's sample shows 1 pressure against 2.2 expected
Text is 1,900+ words including the appendix, above the shorter length the writeup judge asked for
